push notification.note: dutch-rules.md prescribes 'push-melding(en)'; existing strings are inconsistent (pushmelding, push melding, push notificatie). Standardize on the closed compound 'pushmelding', plural 'pushmeldingen'; avoid 'push notificatie'.

share extension.note: No existing Dutch rendering in the repo; 'deelextensie' matches iOS/Android Dutch platform terminology for share extensions.

bottom sheet.note: No repo signal; the Material Design term is normally kept in English in Dutch UI writing. If a translation is required, 'onderpaneel' is an option.

swipe.note: Imperative 'Veeg naar links/rechts' as in existing strings.

long-press.note: Existing strings use 'Druk lang op een item…' for instructions.

tap.note: Imperative 'Tik op…' / 'Tik om…' as in existing strings.

toast.note: Developer/UI jargon, normally kept in English in Dutch; in end-user text prefer describing it as a 'melding'.

biometrics.note: Adjective 'biometrisch(e)': 'biometrische verificatie' as in existing strings.

passcode.note: Apple's Dutch platform term; one legacy string renders it loosely as 'wachtwoordverificatie' — prefer 'toegangscode'.

jailbroken.note: Existing strings keep it English: 'Jailbroken of gerootte apparaten'; 'rooted' = 'geroot(te)'.

app logs.note: Existing strings mostly keep 'app logs' (also 'logboeken van apps'); use the hyphenated Dutch compound 'app-logs' for consistency.

deep link.note: No repo signal; 'deeplink' is the established Dutch tech term (closed compound), plural 'deeplinks'.

server connection.note: 'Add a server' = 'Een server toevoegen'; 'Switch server' = 'Wisselen van server'.
